# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-02 from the 2026-11-02 Hub dump.

- 3,203,760 models tracked, 915,441 declare a base model, 948,653 parent links, 90,445 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
